text:
mira: FYI NorthPort flagged a customs reclassification hold on PO# NP-1976. They say a tariff code review is causing the outbound docs to be rejected in APAC customs. This may delay the APAC portion of our Dedicated racks.
tom: ugh. which SKUs and how many racks? any ETA from them?
mira: SKUs: NPL-CT-GPU-H100-96G (frames of 12 GPUs) x18 racks destined to apac-sg1 and 6 racks to eu-west-1 (consolidated manifest). NorthPort says APAC batch flagged, EU unaffected for now.
lee: can we reroute the APAC racks to eu-west-1 temporarily until the tariff clears? cross-border freight + taxes will be a mess but might keep launch dates.
sophie: legal needs to weigh in on temporary import reclassification — we can't mis-declare. i'll loop in legal.
harry: marketplace launch for APAC depended on those racks for reserved capacity; we have a queued onboarding list. if delay >48h we need to pause onboarding and notify customers.
logistics-bot: manifest NP-1976 status: APAC batch held by customs (reason: tariff code mismatch). EU batch in transit ETA 2026-05-08.
mira: NorthPort suggests two options: (A) expedited paperwork review with customs broker (est 24-48h, fee + potential duty re-assessment), or (B) hold in bonded warehouse and ship later (no extra duty but delays). They recommend (A) to minimize customer impact.
tom: cost/approval? finance ok with up to $12k expedite per shipment?
sophie: legal to confirm, but we need written confirmation from broker before we approve any customs declaration changes.
lee: technical fallback list: 1) allocate hosted overlay for APAC reserved tenants (short term latency/egress cost) 2) shift new onboardings to EU-only or US fallback 3) enable temporary cross-region quota borrowing from eu pool 4) delay scheduled on-prem installs by 1 week. priority 1 & 3 are fastest.
harry: i'll prepare a customer comm template offering hosted overlay + 10% credit for the first month, targeted at the 10 highest-impact commitments.
mira: action items:
  - confirm broker expedite quote and ETA (Owner: NorthPort via mira, deadline: +1h)
  - legal signoff on paperwork flow (Owner: sophie, deadline: +2h)
  - if broker ETA >48h, execute hosted overlay for high-risk tenants (Owner: lee, deadline: +3h)
  - finance provisional approval for expedite up to $12k (Owner: tom, deadline: +2h)
  - tag temporary allocations with `temp-hold-1799998888` for tracking (Owner: lee)
logistics-bot: tag created: temp-hold-1799998888 by lee
mira: NorthPort also said this reclassification might affect two upcoming POs (NP-1980, NP-1985). i'm asking them to audit queued manifests.
sophie: once legal clears the process, i'll prepare the compliance checklist for customs broker interactions.
tom: finance will standby for approval; please route invoices to finance-oncall if expedite is needed.
lee: running spare-pool check now. current spare racks available: eu-west-1 = 8 racks, hosted pool capacity approximated to cover 14 racks with degraded perf. will report exact numbers in 25m.
harry: i'm drafting the marketplace hold notice. short, honest message + options. want to avoid formal delays if we can do hosted overlay.
mira: thanks everyone. keep updates in this thread. i'll post NorthPort's broker quote when it arrives. :pray:
